title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 7: B2 COMMUNICATION & FLUENCY DEVELOPMENT
description: A high-density B2 development world focused on flexible communication, nuanced vocabulary, complex sentence control, natural listening, discussion, writing and real-world independence.

targets.active_vocabulary: 1600+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms and functional expressions
targets.reading: 1300–1500 words with inference, tone, purpose, reference and evidence tasks
targets.listening: 11–13 minutes of natural multi-speaker English with reduced forms, interruptions and implied meaning
targets.conversation: 14–16 minutes of sustained discussion with follow-up questions, clarification, reformulation and spontaneous response
targets.writing: 320–380 words with coherent paragraphs, varied sentence structures, evidence and controlled register
targets.presentation: 6–7 minutes with structured argument, examples, transitions and audience questions
targets.real_life: workplace, education, travel, customer service, digital life, public services, social situations and decision-making

missions.title: B2 Vocabulary Engine — Precision, Phrasal Verbs & Idiomatic Language
missions.content: Replace vague language with precise B2 alternatives, build natural collocations, decode common phrasal verbs and use selected idiomatic expressions accurately in context.

missions.title: Grammar Control — Perfect Forms, Aspect & Time Relationships
missions.content: Control subtle differences between completed events, ongoing situations, experiences, duration and current results while switching naturally between narrative time frames.

missions.title: Modal Meaning — Certainty, Probability, Obligation & Criticism
missions.content: Express degrees of certainty, obligation, expectation and criticism, including deductions about present and past situations.

missions.title: Conditionals in Depth — Consequences, Regrets & Alternative Worlds
missions.content: Discuss hypothetical choices, past regrets and present consequences while selecting conditional structures according to meaning rather than memorized formulas.

missions.title: Complex Sentence Lab — Clauses, Emphasis & Reformulation
missions.content: Combine ideas efficiently, emphasize important information and reformulate difficult sentences into clear natural B2 English.

missions.title: Reported Speech & Information Transfer
missions.content: Transfer conversations and information accurately, choose reporting verbs for meaning and summarize what different people said.

missions.title: B2 Cohesion Mission — Make Every Idea Connect
missions.content: Create connected paragraphs using reference words, substitution, linking expressions and logical progression instead of repeating the same structures.

missions.title: Nuance & Tone — Say More Than the Words
missions.content: Recognize and produce language that shows certainty, hesitation, politeness, enthusiasm, criticism and disagreement without sounding unnecessarily direct.

missions.title: Media & Information Mission — Fact, Opinion & Bias
missions.content: Compare short media texts, identify claims and supporting evidence, distinguish fact from opinion and explain how wording can influence interpretation.

missions.title: B2 Conversation Lab — Sixteen-Minute Discussion
missions.content: Maintain a long discussion on education, technology, work and society, respond to unexpected questions and keep the conversation active without scripted answers.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — A Difficult Decision
missions.content: Read an extended narrative and analytical text, infer motives, identify shifts in attitude, track references and support interpretations with textual evidence.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Natural English Under Pressure
missions.content: Follow an 11–13 minute sequence of interviews, discussions and real-life conversations while identifying key information, speaker intention and implied meaning.

missions.title: Writing Lab — Balanced Argument & Counterargument
missions.content: Write a balanced argument that introduces an issue, develops multiple reasons, acknowledges an alternative view, evaluates evidence and reaches a clear conclusion.

missions.title: Presentation Lab — Inform, Analyze & Defend
missions.content: Deliver a structured presentation, explain a problem, compare possible solutions, use examples and defend the main position during audience questions.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Customer Service & Negotiation
missions.content: Handle a difficult customer-service situation, explain a problem clearly, negotiate a reasonable solution and respond professionally when the first solution fails.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Work, Study & Professional Communication
missions.content: Participate in a short meeting, clarify responsibilities, discuss deadlines, write a professional message and respond constructively to feedback.

missions.title: Debate Lab — Build, Challenge & Rebuild an Argument
missions.content: Build an argument, listen for weaknesses in another position, ask probing questions and reformulate your response after receiving a counterargument.

missions.title: Decision Lab — Choose, Explain & Adapt
missions.content: Solve a realistic multi-stage decision scenario involving money, travel, study, work and time limits; explain trade-offs and adapt when new evidence appears.

missions.title: B2 Fluency Marathon — Integrated Skills Under Time Pressure
missions.content: Complete a demanding sequence of timed tasks that moves from language analysis to production: vocabulary in context, grammar editing, reading inference, natural listening, spontaneous speaking and structured writing.

missions.title: WORLD 7 MASTER QUEST — B2 COMMUNICATION & FLUENCY
missions.content: Final B2 development mission combining precision vocabulary, complex grammar, inference reading, natural listening, sustained discussion, argument writing, presentation and a high-pressure real-life problem-solving simulation.

quality_rules.assessment: production-first with inference, explanation and spontaneous communication
quality_rules.progression: World 7 repeatedly recycles World 6 language while increasing complexity, speed, flexibility and independence.
quality_rules.protected_note: This curriculum file adds Grade 5 World 7 only and does not modify Grade 2, Grade 3 or Grade 4.
